guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: checkoutservice latency-50/90 rose about 18-19x (z=+117 and +95) and the worst traces are 10s single-span errors located in checkoutservice itself, so its callees are not the source. Its socket count (+33%, z=+6.69) and memory (+31%) also rose while its workload fell 62%, which fits a socket/connection problem in checkoutservice; the 10s ceiling looks like a timeout.

proposed_fix.description: Restart the checkoutservice pods to clear stuck connections and inspect its socket and connection pool usage. Add or tune client timeouts, and roll back any recent change to checkoutservice.
